_note: Hand authored. The asset join is derived from the display name by src/data/icons.ts, and this file holds only what that rule cannot reach: overrides for a file the wiki named badly, and the gaps nobody can close yet. scripts/validate.ts fails the build on an offerable trait that appears in neither.

records.say: The wiki filename kept the percent-encoded apostrophe, so the slug reads executioner-27s-chop and the display name cannot reach it. Four files in the library carry this artefact.
